overview: Reconciled consolidation of slices 0001b-0001f (viewer, citations, highlight overlay, row statuses + export gate, trace export), explicitly derived from plan.md + prd-overall.* minus the 0001a Matter+Documents scope.
goals: Viewer works for pack_01_clean and remains usable for pack_07_scans_rotated_low_quality (RH1 evidence).
Zoom is crisp and stable (no devicePixelRatio drift; re-render not CSS scaling).
Citation payload is sufficient for highlighting and deterministic integrity checks.
Snippet hashing is stable and single-sourced (RH3 evidence).
Prove the trust moment on fixture packs with evidence capture (RH2 screenshots + HUD/bbox logs).
Make trust failures explicit and actionable (no silent failures; no best-effort highlights).
Exports are blocked by default on evidence failure (server-enforced).
Failures are debuggable via a safe trace export (no secrets, signed URLs, or raw content).
nonGoals: All 0001a scope: create/list/open Matters, upload/init/complete ingest, and document ingest pipelines/state machines.
Quick Start runs and workflow orchestration (Initiative 0002).
Entailment verification beyond deterministic integrity/fail-closed checks.
Storing raw prompts/document text in trace exports by default.
successMetrics: pack_01_clean: click-to-highlight works; deliberate bad citation blocks export.
pack_02_missing_rea: missing-doc checklist shown; missing_input invariant holds; FP=0 on pack_01_clean.
pack_07_scans_rotated_low_quality: viewer usable; RH1 perf evidence recorded; highlight behavior honest (aligned or explicit cut/patch).

stack.framework: Next.js 15 (App Router) + React 19 (TypeScript) + pdf.js; packages/core domain logic
stack.hosting: Local dev; default deployment target is a Hetzner VM (Vercel optional for previews)
stack.auth: PoC can run without auth in local/dev; production-minded deployments should enable auth

routes.name: Matter Detail
routes.purpose: Extend an existing Matter detail surface with: seeded report rows table, citation chips, row statuses + failure journeys, export gate UI, and trace export button.

routes.name: Document Viewer
routes.purpose: Render a single PDF page via pdf.js with page nav + zoom; accepts searchParams (page, optional citation). Fetches citation payload and renders overlay + snippet/hash; fail closed on invariant failures.

routes.name: Render URL Contract
routes.purpose: GET /documents/:id/render?page=N returns { document_id, page, render_url } where page is 1-indexed and render_url is a short-lived signed URL.

routes.name: Citations API
routes.purpose: Fetch a locked citation payload { citation: { id, document_id, page_number, polygons, snippet, snippet_hash } } (immutable) for viewer rendering and integrity checks.

routes.name: CSV Export API
routes.purpose: Server-enforced export gating: block when any row is citation_failed unless an explicit demo-only unsafe override is enabled.

routes.name: Trace Export API
routes.purpose: Return a safe JSON trace for a selected run_id (admin-token gated) using an explicit allowlist schema; must use the standard error envelope on failures.

routes.name: RH1 PDF Perf Harness (Dev-Only)
routes.purpose: Run serial/spam page-jump tests and download results JSON for pack_07 scans.

routes.name: RH2 Overlay Harness (Dev-Only)
routes.purpose: Fixture-backed mini-eval for highlight alignment at 100% zoom only (cut) + rotation + fail-closed cases.

routes.name: Local PDF Fixture Route (Dev-Only)
routes.purpose: Serve fixture PDFs to the RH2 harness for deterministic testing (implementation detail).

uiNotes: Viewer renders PDFs via pdf.js and supports page navigation (jump + next/prev) and zoom 50/100/150.
Use server-first fetch of render_url (no client-side fetch-by-default).
Citation chips are derived from citation_id values only (no free-text citations).
Viewer overlays locked citation polygon(s) and shows snippet + snippet_hash.
Fail closed: if any invariant fails (doc mismatch, page out of range, invalid polygons, snippet_hash mismatch, render_url missing), render no overlay and show explicit failure UI.
Report table shows terminal status badges: needs_review, reviewed, missing_input, citation_failed.
Missing-doc journey: missing_input rows show an actionable checklist with concrete evidence signals.
Citation failure journey: citation_failed rows show explicit safe reason codes and are non-exportable by default.
Export UI shows blocked state and why; links to failing rows.
All failures use the standard error envelope and include trace_id.

notes: Matter list/detail route shells exist and can be extended.
Documents can be uploaded into a Matter and have stable document_id values.
Document ingest populates documents.page_count and documents.storage_key (object storage).
Object storage posture exists (S3-compatible; signed URL generation helpers).

signedUrls: Generate render_url/download_url on demand with short TTL (target 5-15 minutes).
Never persist signed URLs in DB.
Never include signed URLs in provenance or trace exports.
Never log signed URLs; treat X-Amz-* query params as secrets.
adminTokenGating: Require X-Orbital-Admin-Token to match env ORBITAL_ADMIN_TOKEN.
Missing/mismatched returns 403 with standard error envelope.
Token must never be stored, returned, or logged.
devOnlyEndpoints: Dev-only endpoints must live under /spikes/* and return 404 outside dev.
Validate inputs with Zod; avoid filesystem traversal patterns.
traceRedaction: Trace exports are shareable artifacts and must contain only ids, timings, counts, code enums, and hashes by default.
Do not export raw PDF bytes, extracted text, prompts, provider payloads/headers, file paths, signed URLs, auth tokens, or PII.
storageLogging: Extracted text in Postgres is sensitive; avoid logging raw document content.
Object storage holds raw PDFs and artifacts; logs/traces/analytics must redact tokens and signed URLs.

nextjsBoundaries: Default to RSC for route shells under apps/web/app/(app)/**; keep client components small.
Use Next.js Route Handlers under apps/web/app/(api)/**/route.ts for client->server calls.
pdf.js is client-only: keep imports behind a client boundary and use dynamic import.
Avoid passing large payloads through RSC props; prefer ids + client/server fetch.

blockedBy: RH1 (pdf.js perf on scans) blocks US-001/US-002

RH1: Range precondition: target PDF URL returns Accept-Ranges: bytes and honors Range: bytes=0-10 with 206 Partial Content (record header proof).
Define totalMs as time from request page N to renderTask.promise resolve (exclude initial PDF load).
Serial test (N=20, 100% zoom): p95(totalMs) < 1000ms and max(totalMs) < 1500ms.
Spam test (N=30 @ 200ms): maxLongTaskMs < 250ms and final requested page completes < 1500ms after its request timestamp.
Cancellation requirement: >= 70% intermediate renders are cancelled (from harness output).
Evidence committed: downloaded run JSON(s) + summary table in spike-investigation.md.
Range proof must be for the viewer's actual render_url target, not just /spikes/local-pdf.
RH2: pack_01: one commitment anchor and one survey anchor align at 100% zoom.
Cut: highlight overlay is verified at 100% zoom only (ADR-0020) and viewer enforces 100% zoom while highlight is active.
Rotation: at least one rotated/scanned case in pack_07, or an explicit cut/patch is recorded.
Fail-closed proof: invalid polygon and wrong page show explicit failure UI and render no overlay.
Evidence committed: screenshots with HUD + bbox log JSON.
RH3: hashSnippet() and normaliseSnippet() are single-sourced (core) and unit tested.
Harness packages/core/src/spikes/rh3_snippet_hash_harness.ts run twice yields identical hashes across runs for the same extracted snippets.
Evidence committed: two JSON outputs + a stability note/table in spike-investigation.md.
RH4: Latency budget: p95 <= 8s per row on dev machine (record p50/p95/max).
Evidence committed: results summary + raw results JSON (and any rubric/prompt notes if used later).
RH5: pack_02_missing_rea: flags REA.pdf as missing with an actionable checklist.
Only high-confidence candidates shown by default (confidence >= 0.8).
Evidence committed: harness output + a short note describing signals and candidate confidence.

spikeGates.evidence: See docs/04-projects/02-features/0001_trust-substrate/plan.md and spike-investigation.md for PASS criteria and evidence locations.

fields: page is 1-indexed and used for initial viewer state/validation
render_url is a short-lived signed URL and is never persisted
provenance_json (missing-doc checklist, reason codes, retrieved chunks, etc)

importFormat.description: Fixture packs under docs/08-example-data/ validate viewer usability/perf (PDF packs), highlight alignment (anchors), and failure journeys. Trace export exports internal provenance/traces (no fixture input needed).

rules: Canonical contracts must not drift: docs/03-architecture/50_api_surface.md, docs/03-architecture/20_state_model.md, docs/03-architecture/30_data_model.md, docs/03-architecture/DECISIONS.md.
Validate all external inputs at route/API boundaries with Zod and return the standard safe error envelope (no internal leak).
All failures return the standard error envelope and include trace_id for debugging.
Viewer is client-only; keep pdf.js imports behind a client boundary and cancel in-flight renders on navigation.

Viewer rendering rules: use viewport CSS px for layout; keep canvas backing store scaled by devicePixelRatio for crispness; handle rotation safely (respect page.rotate); render a single page at a time in this slice.
Citations are immutable after insert; fixing creates a new citation and updates the owning row to reference the new id.
snippet_hash uses canonical rule: sha256: + sha256_hex(normalise(snippet)) (lowercase hex); normalise(snippet): trim; CRLF->LF; collapse whitespace runs to a single space.

Fixture convention: fixtures may reference documents by filename; the fixture seeder maps filename -> documents.id and citations persist documents.id in citations.document_id (never persist filename in citations.document_id).
Highlight renderer is a pure mapping util (unit-testable) and reused in viewer overlay rendering.

Canonical polygon spec: store polygons as normalized [0..1] coords (origin top-left, relative to unrotated viewBox); map to viewport CSS px via viewBox -> viewport.convertToViewportPoint(); render overlay in viewport CSS px space.
Fail-closed highlight: if any citation invariant fails (doc mismatch, wrong page, invalid polygons, snippet_hash mismatch), render no overlay and show explicit citation_failed UI.
missing_input invariant: answer is exactly 'Not found in provided documents.' and citations are empty.

Export gating is server-enforced: block export when any row is citation_failed by default (EXPORT_BLOCKED); exports allowed only when runs.state = completed; unsafe_override is demo-only and admin-token gated.
Reason codes recorded in provenance align with docs/03-architecture/60_observability_and_evals.md where possible.
Trace export uses an explicit allowlist schema and is safe/redacted by default; never includes signed URLs, auth tokens, raw PDFs, provider payloads, or full extracted doc text.
Dev-only harness endpoints live under /spikes/* and return 404 outside dev.

stories.title: Open and view a PDF
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want to open a PDF so that I can inspect evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001: From Matter detail, I can open a viewer route for a selected document.
AC-002: Viewer fetches render_url via GET /documents/:id/render?page=N (1-indexed page) and renders via pdf.js.
AC-003: Viewer shows an explicit error state if render_url is unavailable or the document is not found.
Example: Open commitment and survey PDFs from pack_01_clean and confirm they render.
Negative case: Unknown document_id returns NOT_FOUND (safe envelope) and the UI shows an explicit error + retry/back affordance.

stories.title: Page navigation and zoom stays responsive on scans
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want to page-jump and zoom on scanned PDFs so that I can inspect evidence in low-quality packs.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-004: PDFs served to pdf.js support Range requests (Accept-Ranges: bytes; Range: bytes=... returns 206 Partial Content). Without this, RH1 perf numbers are invalid.
AC-004a: Capture Range precondition proof for the viewer's actual render_url target (Range: bytes=0-10 returns 206 Partial Content).
AC-005: Define totalMs as time from request page N to renderTask.promise resolve (exclude initial PDF load). Serial test (N=20, 100% zoom): p95(totalMs) < 1000ms and max(totalMs) < 1500ms.

AC-006: Spam test (N=30 @ 200ms): viewer remains responsive (maxLongTaskMs < 250ms) and final requested page completes < 1500ms after its request timestamp; intermediate renders are cancelled (>=70% cancellation rate).
AC-007: Zoom 50/100/150 re-renders consistently (no CSS-scaling drift).
Example: Run /spikes/rh1-pdf-perf against pack_07 and record results JSON + summary stats in spike-investigation.md.
Negative case: If Range support is missing for the viewer's actual render_url target, the harness reports the precondition failure and RH1 is NO-GO.

stories.title: Fetch a locked citation by ID
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want to fetch a citation payload so that I can inspect evidence reliably.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001: GET /citations/:id returns { citation: { id, document_id, page_number, polygons, snippet, snippet_hash } } (response shape per API surface).
AC-002: Errors use the standard error envelope with safe code/message (no leaks).
Example: Fetch a known seeded citation_id from pack_01_clean and confirm the response contains snippet + snippet_hash + geometry.
Negative case: Unknown citation_id returns 404 NOT_FOUND using the standard error envelope.
Negative case: Invalid id format returns VALIDATION_ERROR using the standard error envelope.

stories.title: Canonical snippet hashing is stable
stories.description: As a developer, I want one canonical hashing implementation so that citation integrity checks are reliable.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-003: normaliseSnippet() + hashSnippet() are implemented once in packages/core and reused everywhere (no duplicate implementations); unit tests cover whitespace invariance per the canonical rule.
AC-004: RH3 harness (packages/core/src/spikes/rh3_snippet_hash_harness.ts) produces identical hashes across two runs using snippets from pack_01_clean.
AC-004a: Evidence committed: two harness JSON outputs + a stability note/table in spike-investigation.md.
Example: A snippet with CRLF newlines and multiple whitespace runs hashes identically to the normalized LF + single-space form.
Negative case: Attempting to introduce a second hashing implementation is blocked by tests or code review (single source of truth).

stories.title: Click citation chip -> open viewer at cited evidence
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want to click a citation chip and jump to the cited PDF page so that I can inspect evidence quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001: Seeded report rows render citation chips derived from citation_id values only (no free-text citations).
AC-002: Clicking a chip navigates to the viewer with the correct document_id and page (1-indexed) and includes the citation id in the URL/search params.
Example: In pack_01_clean, click chips across at least two documents and confirm navigation lands on the correct page.
Negative case: If the citation fetch fails or is invalid, the viewer renders an explicit citation_failed state and does not attempt best-effort overlay.

stories.title: Evidence highlights align across zoom + rotation
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want the highlight to stay glued to the clause across zoom and rotation so that I can trust what I am seeing.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-003: Highlight aligns at 100% zoom for at least one commitment anchor and one survey anchor (pack_01).
AC-004: Highlight overlay is verified at 100% zoom only (cut) and the viewer enforces this (snap/disable zoom or require reset to 100%).
AC-005: Highlight remains aligned on at least one rotated/scanned page (pack_07) or an explicit cut/patch is enforced and documented.
AC-006: Fail-closed: deliberate invalid polygon or wrong page yields explicit failure UI and no overlay.
AC-006a: Evidence committed: screenshots with HUD + bbox log JSON.
Example: Use /spikes/rh2-overlay to capture screenshots at 100% with HUD visible for pack_01 anchors.
Negative case: Inject an out-of-range polygon (violates [0..1]) or wrong page and confirm citation_failed + no overlay.

stories.title: Missing docs yields missing_input with checklist
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want missing inputs to be explicit and actionable so that I can upload the right documents.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001: Rows with no supporting evidence resolve to missing_input.

AC-002: missing_input rows have answer exactly 'Not found in provided documents.', zero citations, and a checklist with concrete evidence signals ({label, confidence, signals[]}); only show high-confidence candidates by default (confidence >= 0.8).
AC-003: Missing-doc detection flags REA.pdf in pack_02_missing_rea and produces no missing-doc flags in pack_01_clean (FP=0).
AC-003a: Evidence committed: harness output + a short note describing signals and candidate confidence.
Example: On pack_02_missing_rea, open the report table and confirm the missing-doc checklist is visible and actionable.
Negative case: On pack_01_clean, no rows are marked missing_input due to false missing-doc detection (FP=0).

stories.title: Bad evidence yields citation_failed and blocks export
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want evidence failures to block export so that we don't ship untrusted outputs.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-004: A deliberate bad citation yields citation_failed with a safe reason_code; integrity checks are fail-closed and deterministic (no entailment model).
AC-005: Export is blocked by default when any row is citation_failed: POST /export/csv returns non-2xx with error.code=EXPORT_BLOCKED; gating is server-enforced.
AC-005a: POST /export/csv matches API surface: request { folder_id, run_id, kind, unsafe_override } and success { artefact: { id, kind, filename, storage_key, download_url, created_at } }.

AC-006: Unsafe override is demo-only and admin-token gated: unsafe_override=true returns 403 UNAUTHORISED when demo mode is not enabled; if allowed, artefact is visibly labelled unsafe and metadata records the override.
AC-006a: Export is allowed only when runs.state=completed; otherwise return a conflict and create no artefact.
AC-007: Flag citation wrong action records a safe feedback event with citation_id + reason code (no sensitive payloads).
AC-007a: RH4 PASS criteria are met and evidence is recorded: false_passes=0; p95 <= 8s per row; dataset >= 20 bad examples; results summary + raw results JSON committed.
Example: In pack_01_clean, a deliberately corrupted citation yields citation_failed and export attempts return EXPORT_BLOCKED.
Negative case: When runs.state != completed, export requests are rejected (conflict) and no artefact is created.

stories.title: needs_review -> reviewed is explicit and persisted
stories.description: As a reviewer, I want to mark a row as reviewed so that the table reflects what I've checked.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-008: Rows can transition needs_review -> reviewed only via explicit user action.
AC-009: Status invariants hold: needs_review and reviewed rows have >=1 locked citation.
Example: Click Mark reviewed on a needs_review row and confirm the status persists after refresh.
Negative case: Attempt to mark reviewed on a row with zero citations is rejected and the UI shows an explicit safe reason.

stories.title: Download run trace JSON
stories.description: As a developer, I want to download a run trace so that I can debug failures deterministically.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001: Trace export includes run metadata (run_id, folder_id, state, index_version, agent_bundle_version, question_set_version), step records (step_key, step_type, state, attempt, duration_ms, safe error_json), and per-row provenance (question_id, retrieved {chunk_id, score} list, verification verdict + reason codes, citation_ids).
AC-002: Trace export is safe by default: no raw PDF bytes, avoid full extracted document text, no provider payload dumps, and no signed URLs/auth tokens.
AC-003: Failures return the standard error envelope with trace_id.
Example: Download a trace JSON for a known run_id and spot-check required keys + safety rules.
Negative case: Request trace export for an unknown run_id returns NOT_FOUND (safe envelope) and the UI surfaces the trace_id.
